name: @zane-ops/root
description: A self-hosted PaaS for your web services, databases, CRONs, and everything you need for your next startup.

scripts.dev: trap 'exit 0' SIGINT; trap 'exit 0' SIGTERM; set -a; [ -f ./.env ] && . ./.env || true; set +a; if [ -n "$WH_TOKEN" ]; then pnpm exec whcli forward --target=http://localhost:8000; else echo 'Skipping webhook forwarding: WH_TOKEN not set (create .env to enable)'; fi
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -r -k "pnpm --filter @zane-ops/backend run migrate:sqlite && pnpm --filter @zane-ops/backend run dev:api:local" "pnpm --filter frontend run dev"
scripts.gen:api: pnpm run --prefix backend openapi && pnpm run --prefix frontend generate:api
